newsitem.title: UK: Japan reports 23 pct rise in tanker registrations.
newsitem.headline: Japan reports 23 pct rise in tanker registrations.

text.p: Japanese shipping classification society ClassNK today reported a 23 percent increase in tanker and gas carrier registrations last year compared with 1995.
ClassNK said in its annual review it registered 112 tankers and liquefied gas carriers in 1996, a 23 percent increase over the previous year.
Its total gross tonnage of tankers and gas carriers rose 25 percent, ClassNK said, to 1.7 million gross tonnes (gt).
ClassNK also reported a 2.3 percent increase in bulk carrier registrations to a total 4.3 million gt.
It said the increase retained its position as the world's leading classification society in terms of bulk carriers classed.
